title: Towards Autoregressive Neural Network Parameter Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently established a new paradigm in machine learning, demonstrating exceptional zero-shot generalization and complex reasoning capabilities. Concurrently, neural network parameter generation has emerged as a promising avenue for rapid task adaptation and model synthesis. Existing weight generation techniques, however, struggle to jointly learn the distribution of diverse models, to encode heterogeneous architectures within a single generator, and to generalize out of distribution. We therefore ask whether pretrained parameters can be encoded into a discrete domain so that the zero-shot generalization LLMs exhibit in text generation can be transferred to weight generation. Following this view, we propose an LLM-inspired approach, Instruction-Guided Parameter Generation (IGPG), that formulates network parameter generation as an autoregressive modeling problem. translated_title: 迈向自回归的神经网络参数生成
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）近来在机器学习领域确立了新的范式，展现出卓越的零样本泛化能力和复杂推理能力。与此同时，神经网络参数生成已成为实现快速任务适配与模型合成的有前景的研究方向。然而，现有的权重生成技术难以联合学习多样化模型的分布，难以在单一生成器中编码异构架构，也难以实现分布外泛化。因此，我们提出这样一个问题：能否将预训练参数编码到离散域中，从而将LLMs在文本生成中展现的零样本泛化能力迁移到权重生成任务上。基于这一观点，我们提出了一种受LLM启发的方法——指令引导的参数生成（IGPG），该方法将网络参数生成形式化为一个自回归建模问题。我们首先对预训练权重进行量化……
tldr: 该论文提出指令引导的参数生成方法IGPG，将神经网络参数生成形式化为自回归建模问题，通过把预训练参数编码到离散域，使大语言模型的零样本泛化能力得以迁移到权重生成任务中。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes IGPG, an LLM-inspired approach that formulates neural network parameter generation as an autoregressive modeling problem by encoding pretrained parameters into a discrete domain, enabling the transfer of LLMs' zero-shot generalization capabilities to weight generation.
